title: Strategy Rules & Logic
crit_1: 1. 4H Market Structure (Higher High / Higher Low or Bullish CHoCH)
crit_2: 2. Valid Location (Reaction at S/R, Order Block, or 3-Candle FVG)
crit_3: 3. 1H Candlestick Pattern (Bullish Engulfing, Pin Bar, Hammer, Morning Star)
crit_4: 4. 15M Momentum Filter (Positive Slope without Negative Divergence)
crit_5: 5. RSI(14) Confirmation in Standard 40 to 70 Range
crit_6: 6. Volume Surge Over 10-Period Moving Average (Volume > MA10)
crit_7: 7. Minimum Risk to Reward Ratio of 1:1.5 (Risk/Reward ≥ 1.5)
grid_desc: Capital distribution across 30-day S/R range; disabled when volatility < 4%.
